title: Senior Software Engineer
description:
Job Title: Software Engineer II- Backend & Applied AI

**Location:**

Gurgaon/ Full Time]
**Department:**

Engineering

About the Role

We are looking for a highly skilled Software Engineer to build the ultra-low-latency, event-driven systems that power our core platform, and to build the next-generation AI layer on top of them.

You will operate at the intersection of correctness, latency, and scale. You won't just be building faster pipelines; you will be building systems that reason. In this role, you will bridge classical distributed systems (Kafka, Redis, microservices) with modern AI inference layers, deploying Applied AI and Agentic workflows over high-throughput operational data.

If you are an engineer who cares more about
*why a system fails*

than
*why it works*

, and you prefer staring at flame graphs and Kafka consumer lag over building purely greenfield CRUD apps, this is the role for you.

What You Will Do

* **Architect High-Scale Backend Systems:**

  Design and re-architect critical pipelines around event-driven processing to drive down processing times (e.g., from T+2 to T+0).
* **Optimize for Performance:**

  Radically reduce DB CPU utilization through query optimization, table partitioning, and Redis-backed caching strategies. Eliminate redundant queries and decouple databases to remove shared bottlenecks.
* **Build Applied AI & Agentic Workflows:**

  Develop LLM-powered workflows and RAG pipelines for transaction intelligence and anomaly detection.
* **Design Autonomous Agents:**

  Build agents utilizing tool-use, function calling, and multi-step reasoning that can dynamically decide when to query SQL versus retrieving from a vector store.
* **Modernize Legacy Architecture:**

  Lead the migration of legacy microservices (e.g., PHP to Java/Spring Boot) to cut latency and unblock future scaling.
* **Evaluate & Monitor:**

  Implement strict evaluation harnesses for AI retrieval quality (precision@k, MRR) and end-to-end agent reliability. Set up comprehensive dashboards and alerting (Grafana) for strict SLAs.
* **Develop Reusable Frameworks:**

  Design generic rule engines and auxiliary services to offload processing from core operational hot-paths.

What We Are Looking For

**Experience:**

4+ years of software engineering experience, ideally in healthtech or healthcare industry

**Core Backend Stack:**

* Deep expertise in
  **Java**

  and
  **Spring Boot**

  .
* Strong experience with Event-Driven Architecture using
  **Kafka**

  (or ActiveMQ).
* Proficiency in database architecture and caching:
  **MySQL**

  (optimization, partitioning) and
  **Redis**

  .
* Solid understanding of Microservices architecture and handling concurrency (producer-consumer patterns, worker-pools).

**Applied AI / ML Stack:**

* Proficiency in
  **Python**

  and
  **FastAPI**

  for AI service layers.
* Hands-on experience with
  **LLMs**

  , Prompt Engineering, and APIs (OpenAI, Anthropic).
* Experience building
  **RAG**

  pipelines and working with
  **Vector Databases**

  (e.g., pgvector).
* Familiarity with AI orchestration frameworks like
  **LangChain**

  and
  **LlamaIndex**

  .

**Tooling & DevOps:**

* Kubernetes, Docker, Linux.
* Strong testing practices using JUnit and Mockito (aiming for 95%+ coverage on critical paths).

Observability and monitoring using Grafana.

**Who You Are**

* **A First-Principles Thinker:**

  You know that prompts and models are the easy part of AI; you focus on the real engineering challenges of latency, cost, evaluation, and reliability.
* **A Performance Nut:**

  You are comfortable reading slow query logs and flame graphs to squeeze out every millisecond of latency.
* **An Owner:**

  You take full ownership of the reliability, latency, and cost of the systems you ship.

﻿
We’re looking for a Founding Platform Engineer / Senior Staff Engineer to help architect and build the technology foundations of AviniaHCS.

This is an early engineering role with significant ownership across cloud infrastructure, distributed systems, backend engineering, mobile applications and healthcare data platforms.

What You’ll Build

1. Cloud & Platform Engineering

\\* Architect and build our cloud-native platform on Google Cloud.

\\* Design multi-region infrastructure across the US and India.

\\* Build isolated production, staging, development and sandbox environments.

\\* Establish internal developer platforms, SDKs, service catalogs and CMDB.

\\* Build scalable backend services, APIs and event-driven architectures.

\\* Own infrastructure as code, CI/CD, observability and production reliability.

2. Mobile Engineering: Flutter, iOS & Android

\\* Architect and scale our Flutter applications across Web, iOS and Android.

\\* Evolve our existing Flutter Web application into production-grade mobile applications.

\\* Build reusable Flutter SDKs, component libraries and mobile architecture.

\\* Implement native integrations using Swift, Kotlin and Flutter platform channels.

\\* Integrate Apple HealthKit and Android Health Connect.

\\* Build secure authentication, biometrics, local storage and synchronization.

\\* Own mobile CI/CD, automated testing, signing, TestFlight and App Store / Play Store releases.

\\* Establish mobile security, performance monitoring and production release practices.

3. Healthcare Data & Interoperability

\\* Build healthcare data infrastructure using HL7 FHIR R4 and SMART on FHIR.

\\* Integrate EHR platforms such as Epic and Oracle Health.

\\* Build integrations with India’s ABDM ecosystem.

\\* Connect insurance providers, payer APIs and claims infrastructure.

\\* Build data ingestion, normalization, identity resolution and provenance pipelines.

\\* Design reliable synchronization and event-driven data processing systems.

4. Security & Compliance Engineering

\\* Build healthcare-grade security and privacy infrastructure.

\\* Implement encryption, KMS, IAM, secrets management and granular authorization.

\\* Build centralized audit logging and compliance infrastructure.

\\* Establish isolated patient data environments.

\\* Engineer systems supporting HIPAA obligations, SOC 2 and India DPDP requirements.

\\* Support security assessments, penetration testing and vendor BAA/DPA requirements.

5. AI & Healthcare Intelligence Infrastructure

\\* Build infrastructure for Patient Memory and healthcare intelligence.

\\* Integrate Vertex AI and approved foundation model services.

\\* Support clinical RAG, vector retrieval and healthcare knowledge graphs.

\\* Build secure AI orchestration and inference infrastructure.

\\* Establish AI observability, evaluation and governance.

What We’re Looking For

\\* 7+ years of software engineering experience.

\\* Strong experience building production-grade distributed systems and backend platforms.

\\* Hands-on experience with GCP or equivalent cloud infrastructure.

\\* Strong backend engineering skills in Python, Go, Java or similar languages.

\\* Experience with PostgreSQL, APIs, messaging systems and event-driven architectures.

\\* Strong hands-on Flutter experience and understanding of mobile architecture.

\\* Experience shipping applications to Apple App Store and Google Play Store.

\\* Understanding of native iOS/Android development, Swift, Kotlin and platform integrations.

\\* Experience with CI/CD, Terraform, observability and production operations.

\\* Strong architectural judgment and an ability to translate designs into working systems.

\\* A high degree of ownership and comfort working in an early-stage engineering environment.

Bonus Points

\\* Experience with FHIR, SMART on FHIR, Epic, Oracle Health or ABDM.

\\* Experience building HIPAA-regulated or sensitive-data platforms.

\\* Experience with SOC 2 and security engineering.

\\* Experience with Apple HealthKit and Android Health Connect.

\\* Experience with multi-region, multi-tenant cloud architectures.

\\* Experience with GKE, Cloud Run, Pub/Sub and Vertex AI.

\\* Experience building internal developer platforms and reusable SDKs.

\\* Experience with LLM infrastructure and AI agent platforms.

Our Technology Stack

Google Cloud | Flutter | Dart | Python | FastAPI | Go | PostgreSQL | Terraform | Cloud Run | GKE | Pub/Sub | FHIR R4 | HealthKit | Health Connect | Vertex AI

Why AviniaHCS?

You’ll be joining at an early stage and have meaningful ownership over the architecture and engineering foundations of the platform.

You’ll work across cloud infrastructure, mobile applications, healthcare interoperability and AI, solving problems that sit at the intersection of distributed systems, healthcare and intelligent software.

We’re looking for engineers who don’t just build features, but build platforms that enable entire products and engineering teams.

If building a healthcare technology platform from the ground up excites you, we’d love to hear from you.

description:
**Hiring for BRAHMA AI**
— via Flexiple, the recruiting partner on this role.

**About the Company**

BRAHMA AI builds an enterprise AI content platform for media, entertainment and brand content teams. Its BRAHMA AI Core (BAIC) platform grew out of the CLEAR media asset management system and helps organisations ingest, manage, search and localise large libraries of video and media, while BRAHMA AI Studio adds generative AI for content creation. The engineering team in Bengaluru is modernising the core platform and adding AI capabilities across it, and this hire strengthens that work.

**About the Role**

As a Senior Software Engineer (Backend) at BRAHMA AI in Bengaluru, you'll design and build the services behind the BAIC platform: microservices in Go, Python and .NET, the data stores and search that power media workflows, and the React micro-frontends on top of them. This is a full-time, on-site role working directly with BRAHMA AI.

**What you'll do**

* Design, build and maintain scalable backend microservices for the BAIC platform in Go, Python and .NET.
* Model and optimise data in PostgreSQL and MongoDB for media metadata, workflows and assets.
* Build search over large media libraries with Elasticsearch or OpenSearch.
* Build and improve React micro-frontends that sit on top of your services.
* Deploy to AWS and Azure and keep CI/CD pipelines in Jenkins, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps fast and reliable.
* Pay down technical debt, modernise legacy platform services, review code and contribute to architecture and documentation.

**What you bring**

* 5+ years of software engineering experience, with a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science or Engineering.
* Strong production backend development in at least one of Go, Python or .NET (C#/ASP.NET). Strength in one is enough; willingness to work across the others is expected.
* Hands-on React experience, ideally with microservices and micro-frontend architectures.
* Working knowledge of PostgreSQL/SQL and MongoDB, and of a search engine such as Elasticsearch or OpenSearch.
* Has deployed and run services on AWS or Azure, with CI/CD in Jenkins, GitHub Actions or Azure DevOps.
* Experience building an enterprise SaaS or media-tech product, in an agile team.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with media asset management, OTT, video or content platforms.
* Exposure to integrating AI/ML models into product workflows.
* Experience modernising legacy services into cloud-native microservices.

title: Generative AI Engineer
description:
**Generative AI Engineer**

**Company:**
IRISS, Inc.

**Location:**
Bengaluru, Karnataka, India

Full-Time

**Experience Required:**
5+ Years

Website: IRISS | YouTube: IRISS

**About IRISS**

IRISS is a global leader in industrial safety and condition-based monitoring technologies, trusted by power generation, data center, and critical infrastructure teams worldwide.

Headquartered in the United States, with manufacturing operations in Bradenton, Florida, and a global presence across LATAM, EMEA, APAC, and India, IRISS develops innovative solutions that make maintenance safer, smarter, and more connected.

Our technologies help organizations prevent equipment failures, reduce operational risks, improve reliability, and protect their people.

At the heart of everything we do is our guiding principle:
**We Humanize Safety.**

We are committed to developing advanced, intuitive technologies that empower people and transform how industries approach safety and reliability.

**About the Role**

IRISS is seeking an experienced and innovative
**Generative AI Engineer**
to join our technology team in Bengaluru, India.

This position will play a critical role in designing, developing, and deploying AI-powered applications that transform complex enterprise data into meaningful, actionable business insights.

You will help build a conversational analytics platform that enables users to ask questions in natural language and receive accurate, secure, and understandable answers through dashboards, reports, and data visualizations.

Working closely with backend engineers, frontend developers, and technical stakeholders, you will develop AI services involving large language models (LLMs), retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), natural-language-to-SQL generation, and enterprise data integration.

The ideal candidate has strong Python development skills, practical experience deploying generative AI applications, and a solid understanding of AWS cloud infrastructure and secure, scalable software architecture.

**hands-on engineering position**

* Build end-to-end conversational AI workflows involving natural-language understanding, contextual retrieval, SQL generation, query validation, and response generation.

* Integrate commercial and open-source large language models through platforms such as OpenAI, Anthropic, Amazon Bedrock, and Hugging Face.

* Develop and optimize prompts, model orchestration workflows, and AI response validation mechanisms.

* Implement multi-turn conversational experiences with contextual memory and reliable conversation-state management.

* Evaluate AI model performance and improve response accuracy, reliability, and efficiency.

**Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) & Data Integration**

* Design and implement RAG pipelines using embeddings, vector databases, and enterprise knowledge sources.

* Develop contextual retrieval mechanisms that provide accurate, relevant information while maintaining tenant isolation.

* Integrate vector search technologies such as OpenSearch, FAISS, Pinecone, or ChromaDB.

* Build natural-language-to-SQL capabilities that translate business questions into validated database queries.

* Implement safeguards to enforce data-access policies, query restrictions, and enterprise security requirements.

* Collaborate with data engineering and application development teams to integrate AI capabilities with existing systems.

**Python Development & AI Microservices**

* Design and maintain modular, secure, and production-ready AI service architectures.

* Integrate AI services with existing backend applications, frontend interfaces, and enterprise analytics platforms.

* Develop automated tests and validation procedures to ensure application quality and reliability.

* Maintain technical documentation, architecture decision records, and development standards.

* Deploy, configure, and maintain AI applications and supporting services within AWS environments.

* Work with AWS technologies such as Amazon Bedrock, OpenSearch, Kendra, Lambda, ECS, EC2, S3, API Gateway, and CloudWatch.

* Support containerized application deployment using Docker and established CI/CD pipelines.

* Monitor application performance, infrastructure efficiency, response latency, and operational reliability.

* Identify and implement improvements to scalability, system availability, and infrastructure utilization.

**AI Performance, Security & Continuous Improvement**

* Develop evaluation and monitoring capabilities to measure AI response quality, SQL accuracy, latency, and user feedback.

* Implement security controls that protect enterprise information and enforce multi-tenant data isolation.

* Support responsible AI development through appropriate validation, access controls, and data governance practices.

* Troubleshoot production issues, identify root causes, and implement corrective improvements.

* Collaborate with engineering teams to deliver intuitive, reliable, and scalable AI-driven analytics experiences.

  **3 years developing and deploying AI-powered applications, conversational AI solutions, or chatbots**

  **Python development experience**

The successful candidate should be comfortable developing production-ready generative AI applications, working with enterprise data, and integrating AI capabilities into existing software platforms.

You should have a strong understanding of how to balance AI innovation with security, reliability, scalability, and performance.

We value individuals who take ownership of their work, collaborate effectively across technical teams, and continuously look for opportunities to improve the quality and effectiveness of the solutions they develop.

* Deliver reliable conversational AI solutions that transform natural-language business questions into accurate, actionable insights.

* Develop secure and scalable RAG pipelines and AI microservices that integrate with enterprise applications.

* Ensure generated SQL queries are validated and comply with established data-access policies.

* Maintain strict tenant isolation and appropriate enterprise security controls.

* Improve AI response accuracy, application performance, reliability, and user experience.

At IRISS, you'll have the opportunity to contribute to innovative technologies that improve industrial safety, equipment reliability, and operational performance worldwide.

You'll work with modern generative AI technologies and collaborate with engineering teams developing intelligent, connected solutions for industrial environments.

Your contributions will help shape the future of conversational analytics and AI-powered insights within our growing SaaS and IoT technology ecosystem.

We offer a collaborative, innovation-driven environment where technical expertise, problem-solving, and continuous improvement are valued.

**Join IRISS and help us advance our mission: We Humanize Safety.**

Interested candidates are encouraged to apply through LinkedIn by submitting an updated resume highlighting their experience in generative AI development, Python programming, LLM integration, RAG architectures, and AWS cloud technologies.

Candidates with experience developing production-ready conversational AI applications, enterprise analytics platforms, or secure multi-tenant SaaS solutions are especially encouraged to apply.

title: Senior/Staff Deep Learning Compiler Engineer
description:

Our technology powers intelligent edge devices across automotive, industrial, robotics, and embedded systems.
  
  
Founded in 2016 and based in downtown Burlingame, California, Quadric is building the world's first supercomputer designed for the real-time needs of edge devices. Quadric aims to empower developers in every industry with superpowers to create tomorrow's technology, today. The company was co-founded by technologists from MIT and Carnegie Mellon, who were previously the technical co-founders of the Bitcoin computing company 21.
  
  
****The Opportunity****
Quadric is building the world’s first General-Purpose Neural Processing Unit (GPNPU) architecture, bringing high-performance AI, DSP, and ML compute to edge devices. As a
**Deep Learning Compiler Engineer**
, you will design and optimize the compiler stack (MLIR, TVM, LLVM) that bridges state-of-the-art neural network frameworks directly to our proprietary hardware architecture. You'll play a critical role in unlocking peak hardware performance, low latency, and memory efficiency for edge AI workloads.
  
  
****What You'll Do****
**Deep Learning Compiler Infrastructure & Optimization**

* Design, implement, and maintain compiler optimization passes targeting Quadric’s processor architecture using frameworks like MLIR, Apache TVM, or LLVM.
* Develop lowering pathways from high-level machine learning frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX) down to optimized low-level kernel code.
* Optimize neural network performance for memory throughput, latency, compute unit utilization, and power consumption.

**Neural Network Model Parsing & Graph Transformation**

* Implement graph-level optimizations, including operator fusion, layout transformation, quantization (INT8/FP16), and memory allocation strategies.
* Analyze novel deep learning model topologies (Transformers, CNNs, Vision-Language Models) and extend compiler support for new operators and primitives.
* Benchmark and profile end-to-end model performance to identify and resolve compiler bottlenecks.

**Hardware-Software Co-Design**

* Collaborate closely with hardware and micro-architecture teams to define instruction set extensions, hardware acceleration features, and compiler requirements.
* Develop software simulators, functional models, and test benches to validate compiler correctness and generated binary performance.
* Participate in hardware bring-up and validation efforts on FPGA and ASIC platforms.

****What Success Looks Like****
Within your first 6–12 months, you'll:
  
  

* Successfully integrate support for key deep learning models (e.g., modern Transformer architectures or Vision models) into Quadric's compiler pipeline.
* Implement custom graph and codegen optimization passes that deliver measurable performance improvements on target benchmarks.
* Partner with the architecture team to influence the next-generation micro-architecture definition through data-driven workload analysis.

****What We're Looking For****
**Required**

* 8 years+ experience alongwith BS, MS, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.
* Hands-on experience developing deep learning compilers or compiler infrastructures (e.g., MLIR, Apache TVM, LLVM, XLA, TensorRT, or Glow).
* Strong proficiency in C++ (14/17/20) and Python, with solid fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and object-oriented design.
* Familiarity with modern AI/ML frameworks (PyTorch, TensorFlow, ONNX) and deep learning operator representations.
* Solid understanding of computer systems, memory hierarchies, parallel processing, and CPU/GPU/NPU instruction execution.

**Preferred**

* Experience with low-level kernel optimization, SIMD/vector programming, and memory allocation strategy development.
* Knowledge of model quantization methodologies (INT8, FP8, mixed-precision) and post-training/QAT optimization techniques.
* Prior experience working on software stacks for custom AI accelerators, DSPs, or embedded architectures.
* Experience with FPGA bring-up, hardware emulation, or cycle-accurate simulator development.

, we're building the next generation of employability technology, using AI to fundamentally change how people prepare for, compete for, and land jobs.

We're looking for someone who loves building things.

Someone who spends their free time experimenting with Claude, building AI agents, connecting APIs, automating annoying problems, and turning random ideas into working products.

You don't need an impressive résumé. You need an impressive GitHub, portfolio, or collection of things you've actually built.

What will you be doing?

Honestly, a little bit of everything.

One day, you might be building an autonomous AI agent that uses our internal knowledge base to help candidates navigate their job search.

Another day, you might be connecting AI-powered workflows to Zoho CRM, automating processes that currently take our team hours.

And the next, you might be designing and shipping an entirely new product feature from scratch.

Some examples:

* **AI Agents:**
  Build, test, evaluate, and improve intelligent agents capable of using tools, retrieving knowledge, and completing multi-step tasks.
* **AI Workflows:**
  Connect LLMs, APIs, databases, and internal systems to automate real business processes.
* **Product Development:**
  Turn ideas into working prototypes, internal tools, dashboards, and customer-facing applications.
* **Knowledge Systems:**
  Build RAG pipelines, searchable knowledge bases, and systems that give AI agents accurate, relevant context.
* **Integrations:**
  Work with Zoho, Supabase, webhooks, third-party APIs, and whatever else the problem requires.
* **Experimentation:**
  Try emerging models, frameworks, and tools. Figure out what's useful, what's hype, and what we should actually build.

Your job isn't to write code for the sake of writing code.

**Your job is to solve problems and ship products that people actually use.**

Who are we looking for?

We're specifically open to freshers and early-career builders.

You might be a computer science graduate, a self-taught developer, a hacker, or someone who's learned more through building side projects than through university.

What matters:

* **You're AI-native.**
  You've genuinely experimented with Claude, Cursor, Claude Code, or similar tools. You know how to use AI to build faster, not just generate random code.
* **You understand programming fundamentals.**
  APIs, databases, backend logic, authentication, debugging, version control, and how applications fit together.
* **You have good product and design instincts.**
  You care whether something is intuitive, useful, and visually polished, not just technically functional.
* **You're relentlessly curious.**
  When you discover a new tool, your first instinct is to figure out what you can build with it.
* **You're resourceful.**
  You don't stop because you haven't used a particular framework before. You figure it out.
* **You can work independently.**
  Give you a problem and some context, and you'll investigate, propose an approach, build, test, and iterate.
* **You've shipped something.**
  Side projects, automations, open-source contributions, hackathon projects, or products you've built for yourself all count.

Technical skills we'd love to see
  

You don't need to know everything on this list.

* JavaScript / TypeScript or Python
* React, Next.js, or similar frameworks
* REST APIs, webhooks, and third-party integrations
* SQL, PostgreSQL, Supabase, or similar databases
* LLM APIs, tool calling, RAG, and agentic workflows
* Git, deployment, debugging, and basic software architecture
* Familiarity with tools such as n8n, LangChain, LangGraph, or MCP

More important than knowing a specific stack is being able to learn a new one quickly.

**One important distinction:**
We love vibe coding, but you must understand enough engineering to debug, secure, maintain, and improve what AI helps you build.

What do you get?

* **Claude Max subscription**
  , along with access to the AI tools needed to do your best work.
* Real problems, real users, and the opportunity to ship products that immediately make an impact.
* Significant ownership from day one.
* Freedom to experiment with emerging technologies and unconventional approaches.
* Direct exposure to the founder and involvement in product decisions.
* The opportunity to help shape the technology behind a growing AI-driven employability company.

No endless Jira tickets for changing button colours.

You'll be building actual products.

What we don't want

* Someone whose entire AI experience is asking ChatGPT questions.
* Someone who can generate an application with AI but has no idea how it works.
* Someone who needs a detailed SOP for every problem.
* Someone who has completed 15 courses but can't show us one functioning project.
* Someone who treats engineering as just completing assigned tickets rather than solving problems.

How to apply

**Forget the traditional cover letter. Show us what you've built.**

Send us:

1. **Your 2–3 best projects.**
   GitHub repositories, demos, live links, or videos.
2. **One problem you've solved using AI.**
   Explain the problem, what you built, how you built it, what went wrong, and how you fixed it.
3. **Your favourite AI tool right now and why.**
4. **Something you've built purely because you were curious.**

We don't care whether your projects were built for paying customers, college assignments, or just for fun.

We care whether you actually understand them.

**If you're the kind of person who gets an idea at midnight and stays up building it because you can't stop thinking about it, we'd love to meet you.**

Ark Abroad

AI Product Engineering Intern

**Experience:**
0–2 years (exceptional freshers encouraged)

*Build things. Break things. Fix things. Ship things.*

title: DevOps Engineer
description:

* Multi‐account architecture: Evolve AWS Organizations/Control Tower/SCPs, cross‐account roles, and shared services (observability, CI/CD, artifact registries, networking) with clear blast‐radius boundaries.
* Modernization: Partner with teams to decompose monoliths via the strangler‐fig pattern, carve‐outs, and data migration strategies; define microservice standards (contracts, observability, release patterns).
* CI/CD & reliability: Own build/test/release pipelines (GitHub Actions) quality gates, artifact/version promotion, rollbacks;
* Observability & ops: Standardize metrics/logs/traces with CloudWatch/Datadog codify dashboards, alerts, and runbooks. Drive cost visibility and guardrails.

* 5+ years in DevOps/Platform/SRE roles operating production systems.
* Advanced Terraform and/or AWS CDK (TypeScript/Python); authored reusable modules/constructs and remote state strategies.
* AWS depth: VPC design (subnets, routing, NAT, TGW), ALB/NLB, ECS/EKS/Lambda, RDS/Aurora, S3, CloudFront, Route 53, IAM, KMS; experience with Control Tower/Organizations/SCPs.

* Security‐first mindset: Secrets management, encryption, vulnerability scanning, image signing/SBOMs, Policy-as‐Code;

* Cost management: CUR/Cost Explorer, anomaly detection, unit economics/chargeback, Savings Plans/RI strategy.

title: Software Platform Engineer I
description:
**Job Responsibilities**

* Architect and deliver AI-driven solutions that address high-value business needs, including document interpretation, automated decision flows, feedback generation, dashboard creation and approval management.
* Lead the development of agent-based workflows using LLMs, retrieval pipelines and multi-agent orchestration frameworks.
* Set the architecture and engineering standards for employee-facing agents built on the Microsoft Agent Framework and Microsoft 365 Agent SDK, delivered through Microsoft Teams and Adaptive Cards.
* Build Composite AI architectures, combining language models, search, business rules, embeddings and analytics.
* Design, develop and deploy Generative AI solutions using large language models such as GPT, Llama, Claude and similar.
* Design and optimise context pipelines - chunking strategies, prompting structure, memory systems and vector retrieval mechanisms on Azure AI Search.
* Develop robust C#/.NET and Python backend components and API integrations supporting AI agents, Azure AI services and MCP-based tools.
* Own the Infrastructure as Code estate for AI workloads using Terraform, and the CI/CD and DevOps practices around it.
* Define the observability, telemetry and AI performance optimisation approach; drive improvements in response quality, grounding accuracy and cost efficiency.
* Advance the platform roadmap across agent orchestration, personalization, knowledge management and self-service capabilities.
* Evaluate new use cases, propose viable AI solutions, and guide stakeholders through feasibility and solution design.
* Ensure solutions align with responsible AI standards, quality benchmarks and enterprise governance requirements.
* Collaborate with architects, product managers, UX and business teams to align AI initiatives with enterprise goals.
* Mentor engineers, lead design and code reviews, and build a high-performing AI engineering team.
* Monitor system performance, optimise agent behaviours and evolve solutions post-deployment.

**Knowledge, Skills And Abilities**
Education Bachelor's degree or master's in computer science, Engineering, or related technical discipline.
  
  
Experience 6-8+ years of software engineering experience, including 3-5+ years of AI engineering, ideally within large organizations or enterprise platforms.
  
  
Proven track record of leading AI or GenAI initiatives, from concept to deployment.
  
  
Experience owning enterprise agent platforms or Microsoft 365 / Teams application estates is strongly preferred.
  
  
**Knowledge And Skills (general And Technical) Strong Command Of**

* Large Language Models and modern GenAI techniques
* Agentic design principles - tool-augmented agents, planners, multi-agent coordination
* Retrieval-based systems - embeddings, vector search, context assembly
* Proficiency in Python and C#/.NET, developing scalable backend components and APIs
* Hands-on expertise with Azure AI / Azure OpenAI, Azure Functions, APIM, storage and related cloud services
* Extensive experience with Microsoft Azure services and cloud architecture patterns
* Microservices architecture, API design and distributed systems
* CI/CD pipelines, automated testing and DevOps practices
* Mentoring engineers and building high-performing teams

Microsoft agent and enterprise stack
  
  

* C# and .NET application development
* Microsoft Agent Framework (preferred) or similar enterprise agent frameworks
* Microsoft 365 Agent SDK
* Azure AI Search, RAG architectures and knowledge retrieval pipelines
* Microsoft Teams applications, Adaptive Cards and conversational experiences
* REST APIs and enterprise system integrations
* Infrastructure as Code using Terraform
* Observability, telemetry and AI performance optimisation
* Designing AI solutions with a strong focus on usability, employee experience and response quality

Other Requirements (licenses, certifications, specialized training – if required) Experience with advanced Agentic frameworks:
  
  

* Microsoft Agent Framework / Microsoft 365 Agent SDK
* LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, LlamaIndex, Hugging Face Transformers
* Azure AI Agent Services / Azure AI Foundry

**Additional**

* Deep working knowledge of MCP (Model Context Protocol) and tool integrations.
* Vector search platforms (Azure AI Search, Pinecone, FAISS).
* Responsible AI, guardrails, evaluation frameworks and enterprise AI governance.
* Azure certification (AI-102 / AZ-305 / AZ-400) desirable.
